title: The complete symmetric two-radius four-point family has an exact unit-variance moment chart

chart.completeness: Every symmetric four-point unit-variance law with two distinct positive radii and nonzero mass on both radii has exactly one chart representative after naming the lower squared radius a.

scope_guard: This chart classifies two-radius symmetric four-point seeds only. It is not a classification of arbitrary bounded, continuous, growing-support, asymmetric or field-valued laws.
